findings.message: The scheduler helper is invoked with a unit-converted value (delayMs / 1000), but the requirement says scheduleRetry(delayMs) must schedule after the requested duration in milliseconds. The /1000 conversion makes the retry fire ~1000x too early (or treats milliseconds as seconds). This bug exists in the original line and is preserved in the patch. Also no validation of negative/non-numeric delay despite the non-negative requirement.
